claims.claim: Vertiv Holdings Co identity/tradability is NYSE:VRT; current issuer Q1 2026 results provide primary operating/guidance evidence.
Issuer materials are treated as one primary origin; StockAnalysis is retained as a separate current market-data origin rather than independent confirmation of issuer operating claims.

unknowns.unknown: Exact current customer-level concentration and supplier concentration are not quantified in this artifact.

claims.claim: Vertiv raised FY2026 guidance after Q1, targeting $13.5B-$14.0B sales, 29%-31% organic growth, $3.14B-$3.26B adjusted operating profit and $2.1B-$2.3B adjusted free cash flow.
Current market data on Sep. 17 showed about $92.97B market cap, 54.65 trailing P/E and 30.82 forward P/E; valuation therefore embeds substantial growth expectations.
Vertiv supplies power management, thermal/liquid cooling and integrated infrastructure for data centers, creating direct exposure to AI power-density and cooling bottlenecks.

thesisQuality.basis: Power, thermal/liquid cooling and integrated data-center infrastructure directly address AI density constraints; valuation and cyclicality cap conviction.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Issuer raised FY2026 guidance to 29%-31% organic sales growth, $3.14B-$3.26B adjusted operating profit and $2.1B-$2.3B adjusted FCF.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: Sep. 17 valuation near 54.65x trailing and 30.82x forward earnings embeds substantial growth expectations.

catalystScore.basis: Raised 2026 guidance and accelerating data-center capacity investment provide visible near-term operating catalysts.

governancePower.basis: Management is funding capacity expansion while guiding strong FCF; no current governance defect is evidenced, but this packet does not claim exceptional governance.

alignment2036.basis: Critical power and thermal infrastructure is structurally required as AI compute density and electricity demand rise.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Power, cooling, integrated solutions and lifecycle services can be sold across the same critical-infrastructure customer base.

bottleneckControl.basis: Power delivery and heat removal are binding physical constraints for high-density AI infrastructure, and Vertiv participates directly in both.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Broad critical-infrastructure portfolio and global data-center demand support multiple AI buildout scenarios; capex cyclicality remains.

substitutionResilience.basis: Integrated power/cooling engineering and lifecycle support create switching friction, while credible industrial competitors prevent monopoly assumptions.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Strong projected FCF supports capacity investment and shock absorption; complex electrical/thermal component supply remains a documented risk.

pricingPower.basis: Raised operating-profit guidance alongside rapid organic growth supports strong current value capture, conservatively short of assuming permanent pricing power.

riskEvidence.basis: Principal risks are premium valuation, data-center capex cyclicality, execution during rapid capacity expansion, competition and supply-chain constraints.
